data.title: Solving a Childhood Mystery: How BASIC Games Learned to Win
data.author: greentec
data.article_summary:
这篇文章主要讲述了作者回顾自己年少时使用BASIC语言编写游戏的经历，特别是重新审视一本旧的BASIC编程书籍。书中包含一个名为Hexapawn的小型国际象棋变种游戏的源码，该游戏在一个较小的棋盘上进行，目标是消灭对手的棋子或到达对方底线。

文章详细解释了BASIC语言中**DATA**命令的作用，它用于预存储常量值，并通过**READ**命令在程序运行时读取。作者回忆起年少时对这些代码的困惑，特别是源码中出现的大量数字。通过向AI助手Claude.ai请教，作者终于理解了这些数字的含义。

文章还提供了Hexapawn游戏的JavaScript版本链接和源码，并解释了BASIC编程中的行号及其重要性。总的来说，这篇文章通过作者的个人经历，介绍了BASIC编程语言的一些基本概念和历史背景。

主要讨论点：David Ahl将作品公有领域化及其相关资源，以及对Hexapawn和机器学习算法的讨论。

不同观点：
• [kragen] David Ahl已将其所有作品纳入公有领域，包括一本书，并且提供了原书的Hexapawn页面链接。然而，kragen不知道是否有韩文版的在线资源。

• [JLemay] 提出1970年代是许多基础机器学习算法和概念诞生的时期，并提到决策树算法、聚类和集成方法等研究。他还指出第一个决策树算法在1973年创建，强调了早期研究的时间点。

• [louthy] 回忆过去从杂志和书中输入代码列表的经历，提到一个字符错误会导致整个程序失败，而当时并没有足够的知识去修复。

• [diggernet] 讨论了代码中第511行的问题，指出它实际上是以"511 REM"开头，并且在REM后不需要跟空格。

• [jerf] 分享了Matt Parker的一个视频链接，视频内容是关于MENACE的物理实现，作为博物馆展示的一部分。

• [reverendsteveii] 表示想重写高中时期编写的无败的井字棋算法，希望算法从潜在的游戏状态中逐步消除失败的走法，而不是一开始就优化。

• [michalpleban] 质疑为何不直接使用一个较小的走法表，从一开始就去掉失败的走法，而非要从失败中学习。

• [Mountain_Skies] 提到在《The Rainbow》杂志上有一篇关于井字棋珠算法（机器学习）的文章，并认为由于算法和游戏的简单性，使其在记忆中留存较久。

• [jgalt212] 提供了Gardner在《科学美国人》上关于Hexapawn的文章PDF链接。

补充讨论：
• 对Hexapawn及其算法的兴趣和怀旧情感是讨论的一个重要部分。
• 对机器学习早期算法的历史背景和发展的讨论也是一个焦点，尤其是决策树算法的起源。
• 争议焦点在于为何通过失败学习而不是直接使用优化后的走法表，这引发了对算法效率和学习机制的进一步思考。

Background
From my teenage years until now, I’ve kept an old BASIC book. It’s a translated version of “BASIC Computer Games” written by David H. Ahl. BASIC (Beginner’s All-purpose Symbolic Instruction Code) is an old programming language designed to be easy for beginners to use. It was probably easier to use than assembler or C. I remember later creating a text-based game where seven countries fought each other in turn-based combat. It was my first game that I was quite proud of, but I’ve since lost the source code.
The reason this is labeled as Volume 1 is that it doesn’t include all the games from
the original
that I recently looked up out of nostalgia. Perhaps the editorial team omitted some games during the translation into my native language. No Yahtzee! However, they seem to have faithfully transcribed the source code without typos. Since someone has uploaded these to
GitHub
, I was saved the trouble of retyping the source code for this review.
Opening this book brought back an old mystery from the depths of my memory. It was the source code for a game called
Hexapawn
. While other programs were difficult enough for me to understand, this one was particularly challenging.
Hexapawn
Let’s first understand what this game is about. It’s a type of
minichess
. Minichess is a chess variant played on a board smaller than the standard 8x8 chessboard, usually with fewer pieces. The game becomes simpler and more concise than regular chess, and is often used for educational purposes or as a proof of concept. I recently created a
minichess
game with three different game modes.
As the name suggests, this game features 6 pawns, with two players each having 3. The goal is to either eliminate all of the opponent’s pieces or reach the end of the board (the opponent’s starting line) before they do.
The complete source code for Hexapawn from BASIC Computer Games can be found
here
. In this blog post, I won’t review the entire code, but will focus on the parts that interest me.

The DATA command appears, followed by a series of meaningless numbers. -1, 0, 1 appear, then suddenly two-digit numbers appear with 0s, and it abruptly ends. It feels like listening to Radiohead’s music after their 4th album, which I still can’t follow. Can you understand the frustration I felt as a child trying to understand this source code?
So what is this source code? And what is
DATA
? When I asked my friend Claude.ai, I got the answer.
First, unlike modern programming languages, BASIC requires you to write line numbers directly for each line, followed by a space before the actual command. Line numbers don’t have to be sequential, but they’re usually arranged in ascending order. This is because readability makes maintenance and reuse more convenient. When I learned it in the old days, I used line numbers in increments of 10 like 10, 20, 30. This was because you might need to insert other line numbers like 15 in between.
For example, a BASIC code that receives a value A and immediately prints it would look like this:
10
INPUT
A
20
PRINT
A
In BASIC syntax,
DATA
is a command that pre-stores constant values to be used during program execution. During execution, these data can be read sequentially through the
READ
command.

A

data.title: UK: Phone networks down: EE, BT, Three, Vodafone, O2 not working in mass outage
data.author: oger
data.article_summary: 本文主要报道了英国多家主要电话网络（如BT、EE、Three和Vodafone）在某日下午发生大规模中断，导致数百万用户无法接打电话。用户在社交媒体上表达了 frustration，各公司发言人分别致歉并表示正在紧急修复问题。根据DownDetector地图，伦敦、伯明翰、曼彻斯特和格拉斯哥受影响最严重。O2用户虽有报告问题，但公司称其网络正常，问题源于其他运营商的故障。与此同时，《独立报》强调其在重要时刻进行深入报道的承诺，并呼吁读者支持其无付费墙的新闻服务。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：英国多家电信运营商（如BT/EE、Vodafone、O2）的服务中断问题及其可能原因

不同观点：
• **服务中断的确认与否认**：
   - **amiga386**：确认BT和EE存在问题，Vodafone和Three否认存在网络问题。O2的情况未知。
   - **MattPalmer1086**：没有察觉到问题，可能只影响部分网络，自己使用的Three网络正常。

• **可能的技术原因**：
   - **yabones**：猜测可能与2022年Rogers通信公司的大规模中断相似，可能是BGP（边界网关协议）配置错误。
   - **ivan_gammel**：联想到俄罗斯此前因“主权互联网”基础设施升级导致的中断，询问是否存在国家层面的基础设施更新。
   - **situationista**：猜测与Starlink的中断是否有关，尽管可能性不大，但时间点上的巧合值得注意。
   - **gandalfian**：Vodafone的MVNO数据正常，但无法打电话或发短信，O2和EE早期也无法打电话，但后来恢复正常。

• **用户体验与投诉**：
   - **rwmj**：BT的座机无拨号音，但通过Openreach的互联网正常。
   - **18172828286177**：质疑运营商没有及时向用户通报问题，指出对依赖电话的重要场景（如等待医生来电）可能造成影响。
   - **jonathantf2**：指出问题仅影响拨打EE号码的来电，如果号码已转网则不受影响。
   - **heraldgeezer**：文章未明确说明是语音、数据问题，还是两者皆有，且未说明涉及的网络代次（2G/3G/4G/5G），但多数投诉似乎与语音通话有关。

补充讨论：
• **对DownDetector的质疑**：
   - **chmod775**：指出DownDetector的报告地图可能仅反映人口密集区域的投诉，而非实际问题分布，质疑其准确性。
   - **wut42**：批评DownDetector夸大其词，认为其报道经常将小问题渲染成大规模中断。

• **其他猜测**：
   - **kerv**：开玩笑地问是否与Starlink有关。
   - **te_chris**：简单表示EE在伦敦正常。

争议焦点：
• 争议的焦点之一是服务中断的范围和影响程度，部分用户未察觉到问题，而其他用户则受到明显影响。
• 另一争议点是对DownDetector等第三方报告的可靠性，部分用户认为这些报告夸大或不准确。

总结：讨论围绕英国电信服务中断的技术原因、用户体验、运营商的沟通问题以及第三方报告的可靠性展开，反映了不同用户对同一事件的多种视角和体验。

Several major phone networks in the UK appear to be down following a major outage.
BT,
EE
, Three and
Vodafone
were all suffering issues on Thursday afternoon, according to Downdetector.
Millions of customers are unable to make or receive calls, with many taking to social media to report the problem.
“I can’t make or receive any calls,” one EE user
wrote
on X. “All I get is beep beep.”
A Vodafone user wrote: “I can’t get through to my dad.”
A spokesperson for Vodafone said the network is experiencing difficulties.
“We're really sorry, but due to some technical issues some customers will be experiencing issues making or receiving calls,” the spokesperson said.
“We know how important it is for you to have this working and we're working really hard to fix this as soon as possible.”
A representative for EE told several users on X that it is “looking into” the issue.
Outage map for EE
(
DownDetector
)
A map showing reports of EE outage reports made to DownDetector suggests that those in London, Birmingham, Manchester and Glasgow are the worst affected.
Some O2 customers reported issues, however a spokesperson for the company said that its network is operating “entirely as normal” today.
“The only reason behind the small spike on Down Detector – which is significantly smaller than other providers – is simply due to issues some of our customers might experience trying to contact friends or family who are with operators which are experiencing issues today,” the O2 spokesperson told
The Independent
. “It’s not an issue with our network.”

   - **situationista**：猜测与Starlink的中断是否有关，尽管可能性不大，但时间点上的巧合值得注意。
   - **gandalfian**：Vodafone的MVNO数据正常，但无法打电话或发短信，O2和EE早期也无法打电话，但后来恢复正常。

• **用户体验与投诉**：
   - **rwmj**：BT的座机无拨号音，但通过Openreach的互联网正常。
   - **18172828286177**：质疑运营商没有及时向用户通报问题，指出对依赖电话的重要场景（如等待医生来电）可能造成影响。
   - **jonathantf2**：指出问题仅影响拨打EE号码的来电，如果号码已转网则不受影响。
   - **heraldgeezer**：文章未明确说明是语音、数据问题，还是两者皆有，且未说明涉及的网络代次（2G/3G/4G/5G），但多数投诉似乎与语音通话有关。

补充讨论：
• **对DownDetector的质疑**：
   - **chmod775**：指出DownDetector的报告地图可能仅反映人口密集区域的投诉，而非实际问题分布，质疑其准确性。
   - **wut42**：批评DownDetector夸大其词，认为其报道经常将小问题渲染成大规模中断。

• **其他猜测**：
   - **kerv**：开玩笑地问是否与Starlink有关。
   - **te_chris**：简单表示EE在伦敦正常。

争议焦点：
• 争议的焦点之一是服务中断的范围和影响程度，部分用户未察觉到问题，而其他用户则受到明显影响。
• 另一争议点是对DownDetector等第三方报告的可靠性，部分用户认为这些报告夸大或不准确。

总结：讨论围绕英国电信服务中断的技术原因、用户体验、运营商的沟通问题以及第三方报告的可靠性展开，反映了不同用户对同一事件的多种视角和体验。

data.title: The POSIX specification of vi
data.author: exvi
data.article_summary: 本文介绍了Unix系统中**vi**文本编辑器的基本功能和使用方法。vi是一个屏幕导向的文本编辑器，主要在支持用户可移植实用程序和POSIX2_CHAR_TERM符号的系统上提供。vi与行编辑器**ex**可以互换使用，用户可以在vi中执行ex命令。编辑操作在编辑缓冲区中进行，直到用户发出写文件命令才会实际修改文件。本文还描述了vi的选项、操作数、输入输出、环境变量及异步事件处理等细节。如果终端不支持某些vi功能，则可能默认进入ex模式。vi初始状态为命令模式，通过特定命令可以进入文本输入模式，并通过按**ESC**键返回命令模式。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：围绕文本编辑器及其与POSIX标准的合规性、使用和功能的讨论。

不同观点：
• Joker_vD认为使用"ed"文本编辑器比处理复杂的现代编辑器（如Vim）更为简单直接。
• gpvos指出Vim并非完全符合POSIX标准，因为它缺少开放模式（open mode），并提到自己曾在低速网络环境下使用该模式。
• webdevver将POSIX标准与Linux的关系比作网页标准与Chrome的关系，暗示POSIX标准可能不完全适用于所有Linux系统。
• wahern提供了一个链接，帮助用户探索POSIX标准，强调了该资源的价值。
• haunter提到华为的EulerOS是少数符合POSIX标准的Linux发行版之一，虽然是商业产品，但也有FOSS版本（openEuler）。
• nickandbro分享了自己因喜爱vi而开发的一个类似Vimgolf的应用，尽管底层使用了neovim，因为其API更易于使用。
• wpollock提醒用户Vim自带教程（vimtutor），并给出了在neovim中访问教程的方法。
• chasil提供了一个链接，帮助用户查看所有用户态实用程序，通过移除URL后缀实现。
• userbinator指出vi（以及ed和ex）已被POSIX标准指定，但emacs没有。
• eviks质疑配置快捷键的必要性，并询问用户更改快捷键是否违反POSIX标准。
• anthk提供了一个实际操作指南，教新手如何使用vi和nvi，并展示了基本命令的使用方法。

补充讨论：
• 讨论中涉及了多个文本编辑器，如ed、vi、nvi、Vim和neovim，用户对不同编辑器的偏好和使用场景有所不同。
• 对POSIX标准的合规性问题引起了多位用户的关注，尤其是Vim与POSIX标准之间的差异。
• 提供了一些实用资源和教程链接，帮助用户更好地理解和使用这些编辑器。
• 争议焦点之一是Vim是否完全符合POSIX标准，以及用户自定义快捷键是否违反POSIX标准。

DESCRIPTION
This utility shall be provided on systems that both support the User Portability Utilities option and define the
POSIX2_CHAR_TERM symbol. On other systems it is optional.
The
vi
(visual) utility is a screen-oriented text editor. Only the open and visual modes of the editor are described in
POSIX.1-2024; see the line editor
ex
for additional editing capabilities used in
vi
. The user can switch back and forth between
vi
and
ex
and execute
ex
commands from within
vi
.
This reference page uses the term
edit buffer
to describe the current working text. No specific implementation is implied
by this term. All editing changes are performed on the edit buffer, and no changes to it shall affect any file until an editor
command writes the file.
When using
vi
, the terminal screen acts as a window into the editing buffer. Changes made to the editing buffer shall be
reflected in the screen display; the position of the cursor on the screen shall indicate the position within the editing
buffer.
Certain terminals do not have all the capabilities necessary to support the complete
vi
definition. When these commands
cannot be supported on such terminals, this condition shall not produce an error message such as "not an editor command" or
report a syntax error. The implementation may either accept the commands and produce results on the screen that are the result of
an unsuccessful attempt to meet the requirements of this volume of POSIX.1-2024 or report an error describing the terminal-related
deficiency.
OPTIONS
The
vi
utility shall conform to XBD
12.2 Utility Syntax
Guidelines
, except that
'+'
may be recognized as an option delimiter as well as
'-'
.
The following options shall be supported:
-c
command
See the
ex
command description of the
-c
option.
-r
See the

command description of the

option.

See the

option.
-w
size
See the
ex
command description of the
-w
option.
OPERANDS
See the OPERANDS section of the
ex
command for a description of the operands supported
by the
vi
command.
STDIN
If standard input is not a terminal device, the results are undefined. The standard input consists of a series of commands and
input text, as described in the EXTENDED DESCRIPTION section.
If a read from the standard input returns an error, or if the editor detects an end-of-file condition from the standard input,
it shall be equivalent to a SIGHUP asynchronous event.
INPUT FILES
See the INPUT FILES section of the
ex
command for a description of the input files
supported by the
vi
command.
ENVIRONMENT VARIABLES
See the ENVIRONMENT VARIABLES section of the
ex
command for the environment variables
that affect the execution of the
vi
command.
ASYNCHRONOUS EVENTS
See the ASYNCHRONOUS EVENTS section of the
ex
for the asynchronous events that affect
the execution of the
vi
command.
STDOUT
If standard output is not a terminal device, undefined results occur.
Standard output may be used for writing prompts to the user, for informational messages, and for writing lines from the
file.
STDERR
If standard output is not a terminal device, undefined results occur.
The standard error shall be used only for diagnostic messages.
OUTPUT FILES
See the OUTPUT FILES section of the
ex
command for a description of the output files
supported by the
vi
command.
EXTENDED DESCRIPTION
If the terminal does not have the capabilities necessary to support an unspecified portion of the
vi
definition,
implementations shall start initially in
ex
mode or open mode. Otherwise, after
initialization,
vi
shall be in command mode; text input mode can be entered by one of several commands used to insert or
change text. In text input mode, <ESC> can be used to return to command mode; other uses of <ESC> are described later
in this section; see
Terminate Command or Input Mode
.
Initialization in ex and vi
See
Initialization in ex and vi
for a description of
ex
and
vi
initialization for the
vi
utility.
Command Descriptions in vi
The following symbols are used in this reference page to represent arguments to commands.
buffer
See the description of
buffer
in the EXTENDED DESCRIPTION section of the
ex
utility; see
Command Descriptions in ex
.
In open and visual mode, when a command synopsis shows both [
buffer
] and [
count
] preceding the command name, they
can be specified in either order.
count
A positive integer used as an optional argument to most commands, either to give a repeat count or as a size. This argument is
optional and shall default to 1 unless otherwise specified.
The Synopsis lines for the
vi
commands <control>-G, <control>-L, <control>-R, <control>-],
%
,
&
,

,
D
,

,

,
Q
,
u
,

data.title: Inter-Planetary Network Special Interest Group
data.author: OhMeadhbh
data.article_summary: IPNSIG（互联网协会星际分会）由Vint Cerf及学术界和NASA/JPL研究人员于1998年创立，目标是将地球网络扩展至太阳系空间，实现“互联网普及太空，惠及全人类”的愿景。其工作包括发展延迟与中断容忍网络（DTN），建立太阳系互联网架构与治理，并通过报告和策略推动相关技术成熟。该组织致力于连接未开发区域，促进星际网络的共同愿景和未来规划。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：星际网络和Starlink相关技术问题及解决方案

不同观点：
• OhMeadhbh认为，在Starlink出现问题时，可以回顾Vint Cerf在1998年创立的IPN SIG（星际互联网协议特别兴趣小组），该小组讨论高延迟和可能的高损耗链路上的IP协议问题。他还提到希望看到更多关于信息安全的用例。

• webdevver用幽默的方式暗示Comcast可能会“意外地”通过“碎片”摧毁Starlink卫星链路，隐含对Starlink可靠性的质疑。

• LorenDB认为，星际网络最可能的解决方案是在距离现有数据中心几光秒以外的地方投入大量数据中心和计算资源，并使用类似IPFS的技术在行星间进行数据同步。

• rippeltippel自称是DTNPerf（用于DTN的iperf）初始版本的作者，提到自己已经转向其他软件工程领域，但很高兴看到DTN技术仍被关注，并指出ESA（欧洲航天局）也在研究该技术。

• ieee-e以讽刺的语气评论帖子中图形太多，单间距字体太少，暗示对讨论的专业性质疑，并附上一个指向RFC 1的链接。

• t1234s提出一个开放性问题，询问量子纠缠是否可以消除网络延迟，暗示对未来技术解决方案的探索。

• jibal分享个人经历，提到自己曾与Vint Cerf在UCLA共事，称赞Vint Cerf是个很酷的人，侧面支持对Vint Cerf及其工作的认可。

• userulluipeste对“Solar System”的写法提出小修正，强调应大写，因为这是专有名词，指出我们居住的太阳系应被准确描述。

补充讨论：
• 讨论中涉及多个技术概念，包括IPN（星际网络协议）、DTN（延迟容忍网络）、量子纠缠和IPFS（星际文件系统），显示出对不同技术方案的探讨。
• 评论中存在幽默和讽刺（如webdevver和ieee-e的评论），以及对技术细节的认真探讨（如rippeltippel和LorenDB的评论），形成轻松但富有深度的讨论氛围。
• 争议焦点不明显，但存在对技术实现方式的不同看法，比如LorenDB和rippeltippel对星际网络解决方案的不同视角。

IPNSIG works to expand the Internet into space
Learn more
IPNSIG was founded in 1998 by Vint Cerf and researchers within academia and NASA/JPL. We are now a full Chapter within the Internet Society, known as the Interplanetary Chapter. data.title: Working on a Programming Language in the Age of LLMs
data.author: todsacerdoti
data.article_summary: 本文讨论了在LLM（大型语言模型）时代继续开发编程语言（如Rye）的意义和挑战。作者承认LLM可以从提示生成代码，并且这种技术正在改变编程领域，甚至可能最终取代一些传统编程语言。然而，作者认为，专门的编程语言提供了自然语言无法达到的精确性和特定性，是解决复杂计算问题的关键工具。LLM依赖过去的解决方案，缺乏真正的创新能力，而专门语言不仅是交流工具，更是帮助思考和解决问题的认知框架。因此，作者坚信继续开发像Rye这样的编程语言仍有其价值。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：LLM（大型语言模型）对新编程语言采用的影响及编程语言设计的未来

不同观点：
• **[amccollum]**：由于LLM是基于互联网上的现有代码进行训练的，如果所有人都用LLM来写代码，那么新编程语言将很难被LLM支持，因为没有新代码被写出来，这形成了一个自我强化的循环。以Zig语言为例，由于该语言发展迅速，LLM生成的代码常常基于过时的版本，导致错误。对于一些更为晦涩的语言（如Faust），LLM的表现也非常差。

• **[seunosewa]**：LLM可以被用来教人们如何使用新的编程语言，从而促进新语言的采用。

• **[sshine]**：引用了多个项目和博客，指出像Python和TypeScript这样的输出语言在LLM中表现更好是意料之中的。讨论了是否应该创建LLM无法合成的语言，并认为编程作为一种娱乐活动本身是有价值的，即使语言不被广泛使用。

• **[AllegedAlec]**：提到Alan Kay的工作，尤其是STEPS项目，该项目专注于为特定问题领域创建DSL（领域特定语言）。例如，通过ASCII图表和表格实现TCP。认为这种方法可能对当前问题有所帮助。

• **[dustingetz]**：引用“Notational Intelligence”文章，认为符号表示法的价值在于使我们能够处理新的抽象。更好的符号表示法可以帮助我们处理更复杂的概念和想法。编程语言的重点就是提供这种符号表示法。

• **[blamestross]**：LLM作为序列的自动编码器，能够写出低熵值的代码。这意味着存在更高效的结构可以用于编程。现有的编程语言并非最佳选择，我们需要自己去发现或创造更适合我们意图的编程语言。

• 争议的焦点在于新编程语言是否能在LLM时代得到广泛采用。一方认为LLM的训练数据限制了新语言的发展，另一方认为LLM可以被用来促进新语言的学习和使用。
• 讨论中还涉及了编程语言设计的核心价值，包括符号表示法的重要性以及寻找更高效编程结构的必要性。
• 提到的具体项目和资源（如LMQL、Sudolang、STEPS）提供了实际例子，展示了当前在编程语言设计和LLM结合方面的探索。

44640471.article_content:
Table of Contents
genie
buzz
killing
specific
thoughts
yesterday’s
monkeys
genie
#
I’ve been working on
Rye
since 2018. It’s a project of joy — but also because I believe there is a potential to create something of value to others, eventually.
Even people living under a rock know we’ve entered the
age of LLMs
. I don’t jump to ships too soon, but eventually, even I had to admit:
code
can
get generated from prompts. And in many situations — with a smart prompter — the results are
quite OK
.
Even if you disagree,
genie
can’t be put back in the bottle. Technical progress generally only moves forward.
buzz
#
Trying to persuade programmers to switch to a language you made up is very ambitious (or just mad) on its own. When all the
buzz
is about not needing to use any programming language
at all, it makes even less sense.
The falling tide lowers all boats — and my is not even in the water yet.
killing
#
LLMs currently need programming languages, they can’t just generate executables directly from your prompt. Absurdly they also need examples, tutorials, blogposts, Stack Overflow answers,
which they are now well,
killing
.
LLMs are on the level of transpiler languages (Coffeescript?). They need the host languages — but if really succsessful, they would end up killing the host.
If no one uses Python anymore, will anyone still work on Python? (Just an example.)
Probably, in the long term, LLMs* will have/generate their own runtimes, libraries, and everything else. (* Or what comes next.)
specific
#
So the real question —
does it make sense to keep developing Rye?
— boils down to:
Is natural language the best substrate to declare what you want from a computer?
Traditionally, programmers believed it isn’t. But maybe it’s a matter of
specificity
.
Yes, natural language can be used to declare any solution — but it’s not ideal for declaring a
specific
one.
“Make me a Flutter app where I can jot down recipes and rate them”
vs.
Specific storage. Specific structures. Specific behavior. Specific interface…
Specialized languages—with consistent, exact, and repeatable design—will beat natural language at that.
Like any specialized tool beats a general one at the task it’s built for.
thoughts
#
Languages are not just tools for communication. They are also tools for
thinking
.
Medical jargon helps doctors communicate, store information — and also think about medical issues.
SQL helps us think about data and its relationships.
Functional languages help us solve problems that compose better and cleaner (with less state).
These aren’t just syntax choices — they’re
cognitive frameworks
.
If we lose tools for precise thought, we may lose the ability to have precise
thoughts
altogether.
yesterday’s
#
LLMs are trained on
yesterday’s
solutions
. They are good at recombining existing patterns, even in novel ways, but they are fundamentally backward-looking.
If we stop developing better ways of expressing computational ideas — is this it?
Does progress stop here?
monkeys
#
This also leads to a question (inspired by certain
monkeys
on typewriters) I asked LLMs a few times:
If you leave 100 LLMs chatting for 100 years, will they come up with any original thought?
Or would they simply recombine existing knowledge in increasingly sophisticated ways — trapped in an echo chamber of human-generated training data?
Ask your favorite LLM.
And yes — I still think it makes sense to build a language. Maybe more than ever.
44640471.article_summary: 本文讨论了在LLM（大型语言模型）时代继续开发编程语言（如Rye）的意义和挑战。作者承认LLM可以从提示生成代码，并且这种技术正在改变编程领域，甚至可能最终取代一些传统编程语言。然而，作者认为，专门的编程语言提供了自然语言无法达到的精确性和特定性，是解决复杂计算问题的关键工具。LLM依赖过去的解决方案，缺乏真正的创新能力，而专门语言不仅是交流工具，更是帮助思考和解决问题的认知框架。因此，作者坚信继续开发像Rye这样的编程语言仍有其价值。

data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：创业公司收购中的薪酬和股权分配问题，特别是员工在收购中的待遇和股权兑现问题。

不同观点：
• **强调薪资而非股权**：[stan_kirdey] 认为工程师应争取更高的基本工资，因为股权往往不值钱。他建议员工要求公司提供409A估值、清算优先权和薪资区间，以获得更多透明度。
• **管理层和员工之间的不平等**：[CalChris] 指出在收购中，管理层和投资者通过谈判获得了优先权，而普通员工则往往得不到应有的回报。
• **对员工的偏见**：[chambers] 提到Garry Tan的推文（后被删除）反映了对员工的不公平待遇，偏向管理层和创始人。
• **收购中的实际收益**：[KaiserPro] 分享了自己被FAANG收购的经历，指出收购公告中的数字往往具有误导性，员工实际获得的收益远低于表面数字，且通常通过“金色手铐”方式分期支付。
• **创始人的人品决定结果**：[BhavdeepSethi] 认为选择加入创业公司时，创始人的人品比公司本身更重要。优秀的创始人会确保员工有好的结果，即使公司表现一般。
• **具体情况具体分析**：[lemax] 认为Windsurf的案例不具有普遍性，因为其产品易于复制且缺乏护城河。但仍有创业公司拥有有价值的IP和忠实客户群，能带来更好的退出结果。
• **软件开发的不道德现象**：[mawadev] 提到员工在软件开发中往往被视为可替换的“细胞”，即使提供了巨大价值，实际收益却很少，强调只有银行账户里的钱才是真实的。

补充讨论：
• **对推文内容的困惑**：[crazygringo] 对推文内容表示困惑，尤其是关于员工在收购中被迫放弃已兑现股份的情况，其他评论者也表示类似困惑。
• **成功的股权兑现案例**：[cleandreams] 分享了自己在FAANG收购中获得30万美元的股权兑现，并通过投资实现了财务自由。
• **法律诉讼的可能性**：[jschveibinz] 认为Windsurf的员工应通过法律手段追究创始人的责任，尤其是当所有价值都在员工身上时。
• **对百分比的怀疑**：[skybrian] 对推文中提到的1%的股权兑现表示怀疑，认为没有提供足够的数字信息。
• **对大公司工作条件的批评**：[whiplash451] 指出大公司的工作条件也变得糟糕，且仍存在支付稳固基本薪资的优质创业公司。

争议焦点：
• **员工在收购中是否应获得更多透明度和公平待遇**：推文和评论中多次提到员工在收购中往往得不到透明信息和公平回报，尤其是与管理层和投资者相比。
• **股权兑现的强制性问题**：员工是否可以被迫放弃已兑现的股权，以及在何种情况下会被要求这样做，是讨论中的一个主要争议点。

通过这些观点，可以看出在创业公司收购中，员工、管理层和投资者之间的利益分配存在显著不平衡，尤其是在股权和薪酬透明度方面。

data.title: A GPU Calculator That Helps Calculate What GPU to Use
data.author: chlobunnee
data.article_summary: 无法获取文章内容
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：VRAM计算器的有效性、功能和局限性，以及对不同硬件（如NVIDIA和AMD）的支持。

不同观点：
• **支持特定计算器的观点**：[zargon]认为https://apxml.com/tools/vram-calculator 更全面，特别是它能够理解不同模型的注意力机制，并支持量化和KV缓存的计算。但也提到该工具仅支持特定模型，而通用计算器由于模型架构差异往往不准确。

• **对计算器准确性的批评**：[kouteiheika]指出该计算器对训练内存的估算极不准确，尤其是在FP32、BF16、8-bit Adam等技术使用上。例如，训练14B参数模型实际仅需24GB VRAM，而计算器却估算3.77B参数模型需要62GB VRAM。[kouteiheika]认为通过一些优化技巧可以大幅降低VRAM使用。

• **对计算器实用性的质疑**：[funfunfunction]认为该工具可能是为GPU经销商做的廉价营销噱头，暗示其可信度不高。

• **对AMD支持的关注**：[amstan]和[jjmarr]等提到该计算器缺少对AMD硬件的支持，并指出在实际使用中AMD硬件可以运行大型模型，而Nvidia GPU却不一定足够，这显示了对更多硬件支持的需求。

• **对模型选择的困惑**：[mdaniel]对需要手动输入大量模型数据表示困惑，并认为计算结果不明确，降低了工具的实用性。

• **对具体GPU型号缺失的疑问**：[amanzi]和[timothyduong]提到某些具体GPU型号（如RTX 5060 Ti和3090）未被提及，质疑它们是否适用或为何被排除。

• **对计算器功能的建议**：[daft_pink]建议增加导入标准模型的功能，以便用户了解运行流行模型所需的GPU。[chlobunnee]则介绍了自己开发的计算器，并寻求反馈，希望进一步改进功能。

• **对训练大型模型的需求**：[amelius]提到在选择LLama 3 70B模型后，计算器显示所有GPU都不足以支持训练，反映了计算器在处理超大模型时的局限性。

补充讨论：
• **对游戏需求的偏离话题**：[nottorp]提到了游戏如《巫师4》和《死亡搁浅》的GPU需求，偏离了计算器的主要用途，显示出部分用户对工具用途的误解。

• **对NVIDIA偏重的批评**：[snvzz]指出该工具更像是NVIDIA专用计算器，忽视了其他品牌如AMD。

总结：评论主要围绕VRAM计算器的准确性、功能和硬件支持展开，一些用户提供了实际使用经验，另一些则关注特定功能和硬件支持的不足。

• **对计算器功能的建议**：[daft_pink]建议增加导入标准模型的功能，以便用户了解运行流行模型所需的GPU。[chlobunnee]则介绍了自己开发的计算器，并寻求反馈，希望进一步改进功能。

• **对训练大型模型的需求**：[amelius]提到在选择LLama 3 70B模型后，计算器显示所有GPU都不足以支持训练，反映了计算器在处理超大模型时的局限性。

补充讨论：
• **对游戏需求的偏离话题**：[nottorp]提到了游戏如《巫师4》和《死亡搁浅》的GPU需求，偏离了计算器的主要用途，显示出部分用户对工具用途的误解。

• **对NVIDIA偏重的批评**：[snvzz]指出该工具更像是NVIDIA专用计算器，忽视了其他品牌如AMD。

总结：评论主要围绕VRAM计算器的准确性、功能和硬件支持展开，一些用户提供了实际使用经验，另一些则关注特定功能和硬件支持的不足。

data.author: sebg
data.article_summary: 《Moneyball》讲述了2002年奥克兰运动家队在低预算下凭借数据分析（特别是上垒率OBP）取得成功的故事。球队总经理比利·比恩和统计学家保罗·德波德斯塔利用赛伯计量学挑战传统球探方法，通过客观数据如OBP做出球员选择，使决策更加透明和可量化。例如，他们以低价签下斯科特·哈特伯格，并通过让他改守一垒，充分发挥其上垒能力。运动家队在该年取得了103场胜利，并创下20场连胜的纪录，验证了数据分析策略的有效性。然而，随着运动家队离开奥克兰，该策略也被批评为导致低薪资预算，并被认为夸大了数据分析对比赛结果的影响。文章回顾了《Moneyball》的核心主题及其对体育界的持久影响。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：Moneyball策略及其在体育和商业中的应用与影响

不同观点：
• **thom**：认为分析技术能帮助聪明的组织提升表现，但并不能保证成功。不够成熟的组织可能会因为确认偏误而失败，而中间群体的好工作常常被决策者忽视。

• **timshell**：Moneyball的核心教训不是单纯的分析，而是系统性地评估被低估的资产。在"后Moneyball时代"，传统球探方法重新受到重视，结合分析和传统方法才能获得市场优势。

• **cainxinth**：指出数据统计上季后赛表现不一定反映球队的真实水平，但球迷直觉上更看重季后赛表现，两者之间存在认知差异。

• **rsync**：通过巴西柔术的例子说明在比赛中坚持有效的策略是关键，但非分析派的球探更具人性化，可能在工作中获得更多乐趣。

• **johnnienaked**：运用博弈论的观点，指出如果只有一人使用Moneyball策略，它是一个竞争优势，但随着策略普及，这种优势会逐渐消失。

• **hhmc**：关注棒球比赛中本垒打、保送和三振增加的现象，质疑棒球规则是否需要改变以增加比赛的紧凑性和观赏性。

• **ryukoposting**：认为"Moneyball"这个名称引发了关于低薪支付球员的争议，但指出MLB近年来在缓解“三种真实结果”问题上做得不错，比如引入投球时钟。

• **alexpotato**：分享了自己在大学 paintball 中应用Moneyball策略的经验，强调分析技术不仅在于识别如上垒率等指标，更在于发现被低估的指标并应用它们。

• **hx8**：认为Moneyball的核心在于识别和展示被低估的资产在竞争环境中的价值，因在棒球中的应用而广泛传播。

• **xbar**：质疑谁误解了Moneyball的真正含义。

• **readthenotes1**：提出不超额支付明星球员而是雇佣能够完成工作的人是否是一种反劳工行为的问题。

补充讨论：
- Moneyball策略的应用与争议，包括对球员的低薪支付和市场效率问题。
- 传统方法与现代分析技术的结合，以及如何在不同领域中找到平衡点。
- 对棒球规则的潜在修改以改善比赛的节奏和观赏性。
- 分析技术在识别被低估指标中的实际应用与效果。

Revisiting Moneyball
Data, sports, payrolls, and memes
Pardis Noorzad
12 min read
·
13 hours ago
--
Listen
Share
Zoom image will be displayed
Zoom image will be displayed
Oakland Coliseum, September 2022.
Why are we
still
talking about Moneyball? Why am
I
talking about Moneyball?
For one, I’ve been meaning to write this post since 2019.
2018
even.
Zoom image will be displayed
My friends are the best. From
here
.
The
book
was published in 2003, and the
movie
was released in 2011. It feels silly to rehash, except the whole thing fascinates fans two decades later. Why? On the one hand, it is loved because it tells the classic underdog story while suggesting that nerdy analytics contributed to the wins; on the other, and especially as the A’s leave Oakland, it is blamed for encouraging low payrolls and critiqued for overstating the impact of analytics on the 2002 season and beyond.
Zoom image will be displayed
Zoom image will be displayed
Zoom image will be displayed
From
here
,
here
, and
here
.
In this post, I’ll go over
the author
’s intentions for writing the book, followed by popular critiques of Moneyball. The goal is to address some of the recurring debates as we cover the main themes and provide historical context for each.
Understanding Moneyball
Let’s begin by discussing the book’s central themes and what the author found intriguing about the A’s in 2002. Moneyball has been so influential that many of these themes have since become memes.
Analytics leads to more transparent decision-making.
The A’s GM, Billy Beane, working with statistician Paul DePodesta, used sabermetrics to challenge traditional scouting methods that relied on more subjective evaluations.
This transparency allowed decisions regarding players to be justified through objective metrics. When the A’s signed Scott Hatteberg or traded for David Justice, they could point to specific evidence, like on-base percentage (OBP) or plate discipline, to justify their decision. This approach also aimed to make decision makers accountable for outcomes by establishing a decision-making framework that could be communicated, replicated, and thus improved upon.
Getting on base is undervalued, and teams can use this to their advantage.
While scouts focused on batting average, home runs, and RBIs, Beane recognized that OBP had a stronger correlation with run production than any of the traditional metrics. [1][2]
Zoom image will be displayed
The math was simple: teams that get on base more frequently score more runs, and teams that score more runs win more games. Yet in 2002, players with high OBP were available at below-market prices. Players like Scott Hatteberg (.374 OBP in 2002) and David Justice (.370 OBP) were affordable because their most valuable skill, i.e., getting on base, wasn’t appreciated sufficiently by the market.
The strategy worked: the 2002 A’s ranked 2nd in the American League (AL) in OBP (.339) despite having the third-lowest payroll in baseball.
Zoom image will be displayed
Zoom image will be displayed
In 2002, the A’s achieved 4th highest OBP (.349) with 3rd lowest payroll ($40M) [3][4].
Scott Hatteberg is undervalued.
Scott Hatteberg was available at a below-market price due to perceived limitations. The former Boston Red Sox catcher developed nerve damage in his throwing elbow, making catching nearly impossible and leaving him without a clear defensive position.
Oakland signed Hatteberg to first base for $950K on a one-year contract after Colorado declined salary arbitration. The A’s saw past the injury to identify his core value: exceptional plate discipline and on-base skills. His .367 OBP in 2000 and .410 OBP in 1999 demonstrated an ability to get on base that strongly correlated with offensive production.
The position switch to first base was unprecedented; he had never played the position professionally. He learned first base during spring training with infield coach Ron Washington.
Hatteberg’s 2002 performance validated the analytical approach: .280/.374/.433 slash line, 68 walks versus 56 strikeouts, and 4.15 pitches per plate appearance (3rd in AL). His defining moment came on September 4, 2002, when his walk-off home run against Kansas City secured the A’s 20th consecutive victory and set an AL record.
Hatteberg hit a walk-off home run to give the A’s a 12–11 win and a then-AL record 20-game winning streak.
The streak is historic and remarkable.
The 20-game winning streak (August 13 — September 4, 2002) became the dramatic centerpiece of the Moneyball story.
The streak’s climactic finish, Oakland blowing an 11–0 lead to Kansas City before Hatteberg’s walk-off home run, provided Hollywood-worthy drama that helped make the analytical approach culturally compelling.
More importantly, the streak occurred during a season where the A’s won 103 games despite having one of baseball’s lowest payrolls.

Zoom image will be displayed
The A’s achieved 103 wins (tied for MLB lead) with the 3rd lowest payroll

data.title: Celebrating 20 Years of MDN
data.author: soheilpro
data.article_summary: 本文庆祝MDN成立20周年。MDN始于20年前，作为一个社区驱动的维基，帮助开发者应对迅速变化的网络技术。如今，MDN已成为最全面和可信的网络开发资源，拥有近14,000页文档、超过33,000篇本地化文章以及约18,000个功能的兼容性数据。MDN每月服务数百万开发者，并通过GitHub与超过100,000名贡献者互动。文章感谢所有为MDN做出贡献的人，并邀请社区分享他们的使用体验。最后，文章展望未来，希望继续与全球社区合作，共同推动网络发展。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：MDN（Mozilla Developer Network）的质量、实用性及其文档中存在的问题

不同观点：
• **MDN的重要性与实用性**：
  - **the_other**、**dwoldrich**、**prinny_**、**vorgol**、**kookamamie**、**alexbezhan**等用户普遍认为MDN是一个重要且实用的资源，文档易读、跨引用、并包含实例和互动功能，帮助他们高效解决问题。
  
• **MDN文档的质量问题**：
  - **idoubtit**提到MDN在JavaScript框架和WebExtension文档方面存在问题，包括内容过时（如Svelte教程已有5年未更新）和WebExtension文档质量低，特别是manifest v2的内容不完整且对Firefox开发者支持不足。
  - **socalgal2**也指出SVG文档的质量问题，尤其是属性描述不完整，用户需要额外点击和查找，不如HTMLCanvasElement文档组织得好。

• **MDN的学习曲线与改进建议**：
  - **miiiiiike**认为MDN对不熟悉某些功能的初学者不友好，有时不如直接阅读规范文档。他建议MDN像《CSS: The Definitive Guide》那样提供更详细的背景信息和解释。
  
• **对MDN的个人体验与情感**：
  - **dylan604**分享了自己早期误以为MDN是Microsoft相关的资源而避免使用，后来发现其价值并成为常用资源。
  - **susam**通过MDN实现了创建游戏的童年梦想，特别感谢Canvas API和OscillatorNode的优秀文档。

补充讨论：
• **MDN团队与支持问题**：
  - **Doohickey-d**提到MDN团队在2020年被解雇的传闻，质疑其目前是否仍有专职团队维护。
  - **donatj**和**conartist6**则关心是否可以直接捐赠给MDN，以及如何改进代码块的互动性和可探索性。

• **对批评的回应**：
  - **nonhaver**认为在MDN周年纪念帖下抱怨是不必要的，强调MDN作为一个免费服务已经提供了极大的价值，并促进了对新API的探索。

争议焦点：
- MDN文档的质量和更新速度，特别是对某些特定技术（如JavaScript框架、WebExtensions、SVG）的文档不满意，与MDN整体被认为是一个重要资源的普遍观点形成对比。

总结：MDN被广泛认可为一个重要的开发者资源，但在某些特定文档的质量、更新速度以及对初学者的友好程度上仍有改进空间。部分用户呼吁更直接的支持方式和对文档质量的进一步提升。

44678512.article_content:
Celebrating 20 years of MDN
Joe Walker
July 23, 2025
3
minute read
This month, we're celebrating a big anniversary: 20 years of MDN.
Twenty years ago, the web was growing into a complex, interactive platform that was getting easier to access, but more challenging to build for.
MDN started as a community-driven wiki, helping developers navigate that rapidly-evolving web with an emphasis on web standards.
As the web platform matured and grew, so did the vast amount of knowledge captured on MDN and the community of people who read and contribute to it.
Today, there's nearly 14,000 pages of documentation, more than 33,000 localized articles, and compatibility data on close to 18,000 features that make MDN the most trusted and comprehensive resource available for web developers.
We've helped people of every skill level and background build a better web for two decades now, driving an open ecosystem that billions of people use to work, learn, shop, socialize, and share their beloved creations.
Time to break out the cake
What would a birthday celebration be without cake?
Well in the web world, cakes have a very special place.
There's a long-standing tradition among browser makers of sending cakes to each other to mark major milestones.
A good cake matters a lot to keep a spirit of collaboration alive between teams who compete at times, but ultimately build towards one open web that everybody can enjoy.
Microsoft sent Mozilla cakes for Firefox 2, 3, and 4, and we also sent them one for IE10:
And what better way to celebrate an MDN birthday, than our own birthday cake from our friends at
web.dev
:
A very big thank you to the web.dev team for the delicious cake, and to all the partners, colleagues, and community members who make MDN what it is today.
It would be hard to mention every single person who has worked on and contributed to MDN, and none of it happens without our global community.
MDN reaches millions of developers each month and over 100,000 contributors have interacted with us through
our GitHub organization
.
From the MDN team, a very big thank you to every single one of you.
Your passion, curiosity, and direct contributions are what keep MDN going.
Here's to 20 more years of empowering developers and building a better web together.
Sharing the love
We'd love to hear about your experiences and memories of MDN over the years; tag us on
X
,
Mastodon
or
Bluesky
if you have stories to share.
There's never been a better time to join us in collaboration on web platform docs.
Getting involved means you have the opportunity to write the next chapter in MDN's story.

data.author: frasermarlow
data.article_summary: 本文讲述了一次针对Google的DKIM重放攻击技术分析。作者的朋友收到一封看似来自Google合法“no-reply”邮箱的邮件，声称其账户被执法部门传票要求提取数据。尽管邮件表面看起来真实，但经过深入分析邮件头和DKIM、SPF、DMARC验证结果，发现这是一次钓鱼攻击。攻击者利用Google Sites创建仿冒页面，骗取用户登录信息。由于页面托管在可信的google.com子域下，用户容易上当。文章提醒不要点击可疑邮件中的链接，建议由专业人员在安全环境中分析，避免敏感信息泄露或账户被盗。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：电子邮件安全、DKIM及其局限性、电子邮件欺骗和钓鱼攻击

不同观点：
• **brongondwana** 提到正在研究一种解决方案（包括Google和Yahoo的合著者），该方案通过保护SMTP FROM/TO来防止未经授权的邮件重放，但无法阻止Google发送用户提供内容的邮件。
• **ddtaylor** 分享了自己经历，FBI曾扣押其Google账户资料，并指出实际操作中，执法部门会通过特定部门与Google沟通，且尽量不惊动用户。
• **arianvanp** 描述了遇到的类似钓鱼攻击，攻击者通过发送邮件到googleaccount@google.com而非gmail.com，然后将反弹邮件转发给用户，带有钓鱼信息。
• **sandos** 提到自己也收到过类似邮件，目标是Google域管理员，虽然最终未点击链接，但初期难以辨别 scam。
• **oefrha** 认为文章标题夸大了攻击的严重性，指出DKIM签名包含邮件体的哈希值，攻击者无法轻易篡改邮件体内容，因此这更多是邮件误转发而非DKIM重放攻击。
• **btown** 认为真正的漏洞是可以将URL放入Google OAuth应用名称中，Google会将其渲染到no-reply邮件中，建议App名称不应包含URL。
• **userbinator** 强调即使用DKIM/DMARC验证通过，仍需保持警惕，难以向普通用户解释此复杂性。
• **gunalx** 抱怨主流电子邮件客户端查看邮件头的困难性。
• **igtztorrero** 质疑现有的电子邮件安全机制（DKIM、DMARC、SPF）为何仍无法杜绝垃圾邮件和危险邮件。
• **logifail** 批评文章未及时指出可疑链接，读者需读到后面才明白。
• **rkerno** 认为电子邮件安全如同纸牌屋，建议集体讨论新的替代方案，并建议Google使用不同域名发布相关站点。
• **detourdog** 长期收到类似钓鱼邮件，并通过Google举报页面报告，最近才看到减少。
• **upofadown** 指出DMARC是服务器声誉机制，而非发件人授权， unsigned email 应视为匿名。
• **rvnx** 认为攻击者非常聪明，钓鱼邮件非常具有欺骗性，能通过严格的过滤器。

补充讨论：
• 争议焦点在于DKIM的实际保护效果，部分人认为DKIM能防止篡改，另一部分人认为DKIM不足以防止所有钓鱼攻击。
• 对Google OAuth应用名称中包含URL的担忧，以及主流电子邮件客户端在安全性和用户体验上的不足。
• 对如何有效提升电子邮件安全性，讨论中提出了新的域名使用和集体讨论新方案的建议。

44679854.article_content:
Google Spoofed Via DKIM Replay Attack: A Technical Breakdown
Published on:
April 11, 2025
Last Modified on: July 16, 2025
12 Min Read
This morning started with a call from a friend – clearly shaken. He had just received an alarming email that looked strikingly legitimate. Unsure whether it was safe or a scam, he reached out to me for help verifying its authenticity.
What followed was a deep dive into the message to determine whether it was a genuine communication or a cleverly crafted phishing attempt. The email was convincing enough to create real concern, and that’s what makes this story worth sharing.
This was the email:
The email claimed that a subpoena had been issued by law enforcement requesting the extraction (access/download) of the contents of his Google Account.
What made the situation even more alarming was that the
email appeared to come from a legitimate Google no-reply address
. On the surface, everything looked clean – no typos, no odd links, and the sender domain seemed genuine. But something felt off, and that gut feeling is often your first line of defense.
Ready to secure your email? Get started now!
Digging Deeper: Investigating the Suspicious Email
Curious and concerned, I examined the email headers and link previews in a
sandbox
environment, a secure setup isolated from production systems, specifically designed for this kind of research. On the surface, everything appeared to check out:
The
sender address
looked like an official Google no-reply domain
The
branding
and
language
were polished and professional
There were
no obvious grammar issues
or suspicious attachments.
But as we know, phishing campaigns have gotten much more sophisticated. So, I dug into the
email headers
, checking the
SPF, DKIM, and DMARC
authentication results. That’s when the red flags began to appear.
Important Reminder: Don’t Engage with Suspicious Emails
Never click on links or follow instructions in suspicious emails
, no matter how legitimate they may seem. Even opening a link or downloading a file could trigger malicious scripts or redirect you to phishing sites designed to steal your credentials.
If you’re unsure,
leave the investigation to professionals
who can safely analyze the message in a
sandboxed environment
..
Interacting with a malicious email outside of such an environment could result in:
Loss of sensitive data
Business Email Compromise (BEC)
Account takeovers
Wider network breaches
When in doubt, don’t click – report and escalate.
Here is the URL from that email:
https://sites.google.com/u/34961821/d/1XMIxkFiq54WpH2tKqay2EPnhN0Ukovet/edit
This redirects to the Google account login page if you are not logged in :
After logging in, or if you are already logged in, it sends you to the
Google Sites page
.
Here’s something critically important to understand:
This is
not
a real Google support page.
It’s not a Google sign-in page. It’s not any official Google property in the traditional sense.
Instead, it’s a
regular Google Sites page
,
a free tool anyone can use to build a website.
In this case, cybercriminals used it to create a page that mimics an official Google support case, complete with convincing visuals and language.
Because it’s hosted on a trusted
google.com
subdomain (like
sites.google.com
), many users let their guard down. But don’t be fooled –
just because the domain looks legitimate doesn’t mean the content is.
Start Email Security Check
What Google Sites Is Used For
Google Sites serves as a practical tool for various purposes, including:
Internal team pages (like company intranets or project dashboards)
Documentation hubs
Event landing pages
Personal portfolios or school projects
Simple public websites
You can create a site by dragging and dropping content blocks (text, images, videos, Google Docs, etc.), and it’s tightly integrated with other Google Workspace tools.
When Trusted Infrastructure Becomes a Threat: Google Sites Abuse
Google Sites
, originally launched in
2008
, is part of Google Workspace and allows any authenticated user to create a custom website hosted under the
sites.google.com
domain. It’s widely used for internal and public-facing content due to its ease of use, zero cost, and native integration with Google products.
However, that same convenience is now being weaponized by attackers.
Why it’s dangerous:
Anyone with a Google account can create a site that looks legitimate and is hosted under a
trusted Google-owned domain
.
There’s
no need for custom hosting
or domain registration, and attackers benefit from
Google’s SSL certificates and brand reputation
.
Attackers can
embed deceptive content
(fake login screens, credential harvesting forms, misleading CTAs) under a domain that would normally pass casual user trust and even automated link validation checks.
Now let’s take a closer look at the key elements that make this scam so deceptive.
How the Attacker Performed a DKIM Replay to Spoof Google
This attack was a confirmed
DKIM Replay Attack

data.title: Asciinema: Record and share your terminal sessions
data.author: phendrenad2
data.article_summary: asciinema 是一种免费开源工具，用于录制和分享终端会话，提供轻量、文本化的录制方式，避免模糊的视频。使用简单，直接在终端输入 `asciinema rec demo.cast` 开始录制，结束时按 `ctrl+d` 或输入 `exit`。录制内容为纯文本，可随时暂停播放并复制。支持将播放器嵌入博客、文档或演示文稿中。网站上展示了多个精彩的录制示例，如 Terminal Tetris 和 Worldle-CLI 等。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：围绕asciinema工具的功能、应用场景、优缺点及替代方案的讨论

不同观点：
• dmayle：通过asciinema介绍carbonyl项目，强调其作为命令行浏览器的功能，并与brow.sh进行比较，认为carbonyl的网页支持更好。提供了简短的演示视频，但指出由于asciinema的文件大小限制，演示很短。
• minishlink：强调asciinema可以轻松编辑源文本.cast文件以隐藏敏感信息，特别适用于展示网站操作。
• kragen：分享自己使用asciinema录制各种实验项目（如Emacs命令、Unicode Tetris游戏）的经验，认为它是交流想法的有用工具，但希望加入语音支持。同时提醒用户注意默认上传功能可能导致的隐私问题。
• stevengoodwin：使用asciinema展示其2002年版ASCII pacman游戏，认为这是展示终端操作的紧凑方式，尤其适合展示可能因时间而失效的项目。
• Roark66：推荐使用vhs作为替代工具。
• x187463：分享使用asciinema录制终端效果并转换为高质量GIF的经验，认为asciinema在工作流中表现出色。
• azemetre：询问是否有将asciinema录制转换为SVG的当前维护的插件，并提到已知的termsvg项目。
• userbinator：以幽默方式指出asciinema名称容易引起误解，但承认其为有用工具。
• fduran：分享SadServers使用asciinema录制场景会话的经验，并提供相关链接，同时提醒用户asciinema开发依赖捐赠和赞助。
• pi_22by7：认为asciinema在文档编制方面非常有用，文本方式比屏幕录制有巨大优势，但对自动上传的隐私问题表示关注。
• taoh：分享其团队使用asciinema录制CLI工具并添加到README及CI中的经验，认为效果很好。
• eviks：质疑asciinema相对于基本线性可滚动文本的优越性，认为等待文字出现和控制回放不够高效，且无法使用文本搜索。
• kstonekuan：好奇asciinema是否可用于录制agentic cli会话，如claude代码和gemini cli。
• benterix：分享其认为asciinema最佳用例的链接，认为相关文章解释了svg和gif的比较。

补充讨论：
• asciinema的隐私问题：kragen和pi_22by7提到了默认上传功能可能带来的隐私风险，并对此表示关注。
• asciinema的替代方案：Roark66推荐vhs，而x187463则强调asciinema在转换高质量GIF方面的优势。
• asciinema的功能扩展：azemetre寻求SVG转换插件，而kstonekuan则好奇其在agentic cli会话中的应用。
• asciinema的优缺点：用户对asciinema的文本可编辑性、展示终端操作的紧凑性表示赞赏，但也指出了其在回放控制和文本搜索方面的不足。

44679048.article_content:
Record and share your terminal sessions, the simple way.
Forget screen recording apps and blurry video.
Experience a lightweight, text-based approach to terminal recording.
asciinema
[as-kee-nuh-muh]
is a free and open source solution for recording terminal sessions and sharing them on the web. Read about
how it works
.
Easy recording
Record right where you work - in a terminal.
To start, run
asciinema rec demo.cast
, to end press
ctrl+d
or type
exit
.
Get started »
Copy & paste
When viewing a recording just pause the player and copy-paste the content you want. It's just text after all!
Embedding
Easily embed asciinema player in your blog post, project documentation or in conference talk slides.
See docs on embedding »

data.title: Show HN: Tsbro – TypeScript for the browser, no build step
data.author: stagas
data.article_summary: "tsbro" 是一个让 TypeScript 直接在浏览器中运行的工具，无需构建步骤或工具链。它通过同步 XHR 绕过浏览器的模块导入系统，使用 `swc wasm` 转译代码并转换模块格式，从而实现 TypeScript 文件的直接运行。用户只需在 HTML 文件中导入 "tsbro" 并配置脚本，即可在浏览器中使用 TypeScript 编写和运行代码，甚至可以与远程包（如 Preact）一起使用。然而，该工具目前存在一些问题，如 TypeScript 无法找到模块类型，以及由于转译和 eval 导致的堆栈跟踪难以阅读。为解决类型问题，建议创建一个 `env.d.ts` 文件。该项目采用 MIT 许可。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：在浏览器中处理 TypeScript 编译的最佳方式

不同观点：
• spankalee 认为使用同步 XHR 进行 TypeScript 编译性能较差，建议异步遍历 import 图，使用如 es-module-lexer 或 TypeScript 的轻量解析器解析导入标识符，然后通过编译器主机将文件传递给编译器。他提到 Lit 团队的 Playground Elements 采用了这种方法。

• altbdoor 分享了他之前的尝试，使用 service worker 拦截 TS 请求并用 sucrase 编译成 JS。但他指出 sucrase 似乎已不再维护。

tsbro
TypeScript for the Browser. No tooling, no build step, simply works.
Why?
TypeScript is still second-class citizen with regards to browser adoption,
there is a proposal to fix that
, but until then we have to use tooling, bundlers, build steps that are an impediment for when you want to quickly create a short demo or PoC. There are ways to run TypeScript code but it can't import other files or make use of remote packages.
tsbro
solves this by completely bypassing the browser's import system using synchronous XHR, transpile with
swc wasm
and a sophisticated ESM-to-CJS transpiler so that synchronous
require
is used everywhere:
sync xhr fetch ts code -> transpile to js with swc -> convert esm to cjs -> eval

44634143.article_summary: "tsbro" 是一个让 TypeScript 直接在浏览器中运行的工具，无需构建步骤或工具链。它通过同步 XHR 绕过浏览器的模块导入系统，使用 `swc wasm` 转译代码并转换模块格式，从而实现 TypeScript 文件的直接运行。用户只需在 HTML 文件中导入 "tsbro" 并配置脚本，即可在浏览器中使用 TypeScript 编写和运行代码，甚至可以与远程包（如 Preact）一起使用。然而，该工具目前存在一些问题，如 TypeScript 无法找到模块类型，以及由于转译和 eval 导致的堆栈跟踪难以阅读。为解决类型问题，建议创建一个 `env.d.ts` 文件。该项目采用 MIT 许可。

data.title: Modernish – A library for writing programs for POSIX-based shells and utilities
data.author: sundarurfriend
data.article_summary: Modernish 是一个用于编写健壮、可移植、可读和强大的 POSIX shell 脚本和实用工具的库。它提供了更安全的变量与命令扩展、新的语言结构（如循环迭代）等功能，增强了传统 shell 脚本的编写体验。Modernish 完全用 shell 语言编写，无需安装二进制代码，适用于多种 shell 实现，并可在嵌入式或多用户系统中部署。它还允许将库与脚本打包，确保在任何 Unix-like 系统上运行。该项目寻求测试者与开发者加入，以进一步完善库的功能和兼容性。文档提供了详细的使用说明和示例代码。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：关于Unix shell脚本工具的现代化及其实际应用的讨论

不同观点：
• jonathaneunice认为，尽管像sh、bash、zsh等shell的演进值得赞赏，但本质上它们仍然只是shell体验，而非完整的编程语言体验。他指出，对于处理复杂任务（如时间戳、JSON解析、并发管理等），使用完整的编程语言（如Python）具有更好的语义、类型系统、异常处理、模块化、数据结构和工具支持。因此，对于任何具有一定复杂性的任务，他更倾向于选择完整的编程语言。

• lioeters提供了一个具体的代码示例，展示了如何使用Modernish工具简化和增强传统shell脚本的功能。通过对比Plain POSIX sh和Modernish的实现，lioeters试图展示Modernish在处理复杂任务时的优势。

• pimlottc指出，文档在展示实际命令方面不够直观，建议在文档开头添加简短的代码示例，以便用户快速了解工具的使用方法，特别是在移动设备上浏览时。

• cmcconomy表示，虽然欣赏Modernish这样的工具，但他更倾向于使用系统默认安装的工具，以确保在不同主机间无缝工作。

• amterp对现代命令行脚本领域表现出兴趣，但更希望远离Bash中的控制流和循环编写。他提到正在开发一种更接近Python风格的CLI脚本语言（RAD），尽管其适用场景与Modernish略有不同。

• leonheld赞赏Modernish完全用shell编写，没有其他依赖，认为这是许多尝试“振兴”sh的工具所忽视的重要特性，并表示会采用Modernish。

• cb321对Modernish的`use`函数提出了改进建议，认为应该让`use`处理整个参数列表，以便在单行中实现“方言调整”，从而提高代码的简洁性和灵活性。

补充讨论：
• lorenzohess仅对工具的名称表示赞赏，没有进一步展开讨论。

争议的焦点：
• 主要争议点在于是否应继续使用shell脚本工具，还是转向更强大的完整编程语言来处理复杂任务。jonathaneunice主张使用Python等语言，而lioeters和leonheld则支持通过工具如Modernish来增强shell脚本的功能。

modernish – harness the shell
Sick of quoting hell and split/glob pitfalls?
Tired of brittle shell scripts going haywire and causing damage?
Mystified by line noise commands like
[
,
[[
,
((
?
Is scripting basic things just too hard?
Ever wish that
find
were a built-in shell loop?
Do you want your script to work on nearly any shell on any Unix-like OS?
Modernish is a library for shell script programming which provides features
like safer variable and command expansion, new language constructs for loop
iteration, and much more. Modernish programs are shell programs; the new
constructs are mixed with shell syntax so that the programmer can take
advantage of the best of both.
There is no compiled code to install, as modernish is written entirely in the
shell language. It can be deployed in embedded or multi-user systems in which
new binary executables may not be introduced for security reasons, and is
portable among numerous shell implementations. The installer can also
bundle
a reduced copy of the library with your scripts, so they can run portably with
a known version of modernish without requiring prior installation.
Join us and help breathe some new life into the shell!
We
are looking for testers, early adopters, and developers to join us.
Download the latest release
or check out the very latest development code from the master branch.
Read through the documentation below. Play with the example scripts and
write your own. Try to break the library and send reports of breakage.

data.title: Against the censorship of adult content by payment processors
data.author: SlackingOff123
data.article_summary: 这篇文章讨论了一个拥有毛绒兽设的博主在其博客上不仅谈论与毛绒粉丝文化相关的内容，还涉及应用密码学等技术话题。博主提到，当其技术性文章在Hacker News或Reddit上被分享时，常有人对其博客上的毛绒艺术作品持批评态度，称其为“色情”。文章进一步探讨了支付处理机构被用作审查网络自由表达的工具，特别是针对成人内容和边缘群体内容。博主以Collective Shout和Exodus Cry等组织为例，指出这些组织通过向支付处理机构施压来实现审查目的，尽管它们声称维护道德或女权主义，但其反LGBTQ和反堕胎的立场引发了质疑。文章强调，这种审查手段可能被其他团体效仿，进而威胁到网络上的自由表达，呼吁人们警惕并抵制这种审查行为。最后，文章指出解决这一问题需要政治上的努力，而非单纯的技术手段。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：支付处理平台对某些行业的限制及由此引发的更广泛的讨论，包括 censorship（审查）、支付基础设施的公平性以及可能的替代方案。

44679406.article_content:
This is a furry blog, where I write about whatever interests me and sign it with my fursona’s name. I sometimes talk about furry fandom topics, but I sometimes also talk about applied cryptography.
If you got a mild bit of emotional whiplash from that sentence, the best list of posts to start reading to get a feel for my usual fare is
here
.
When one of my more technical blog posts makes it to Hacker News or Reddit, I will inevitably read some pearl-clutching comment declaring the inclusion of furry art on my furry blog as somehow “pornographic” (
as absurd as that really is
).
Considering the recent action taken
against games with NSFW content on Steam and itch.io
, it’s high time we really talked about the threat of payment processors being weaponized against free expression online.
How We Got Here
The weaponization of payment processors to enact target censorship is not a new tactic. It was famously
used by the US government against Wikileaks in 2010
, and more recently
against SciHub
(for daring to make academic papers freely available online).
This is a problem that technologists have been
acutely
aware of for decades.
Separately, organizations like
Collective Shout
(the one behind the recent Steam and itch.io censorship waves) and
Exodus Cry
(who went
after Pornhub
) have adopted the tactic of targeting payment processors to enforce their weird brand of Christianity onto the rest of us.
On Queerphobia in “Christian Activism”
While researching this topic, I came across many Internet comments that claimed that Collective Shout has anti-LGBTQ motives. However,
I could not find any evidence to substantiate this claim
.
Art:
CMYKat
It’s not necessarily true that every Christian activist movement is bigoted. However, this relationship exists with sufficient frequency (
even if they try to obfuscate it
) that we would be remiss not to at least be
cautious
.
Exodus Cry, in particular, has
well-known anti-LGBTQ+ roots
, with its founder campaigning against gay marriage.
Collective Shout is certainly following the Exodus Cry playbook for censoring adult content online, yet also claims to be a “feminist” organization (where Exodus Cry merely calls itself a Christian one).
Interestingly, Collective Shout’s founder, Melinda Tankard Reist, is famously
opposed to women’s right to body autonomy
. This is generally an anti-feminist position to take, and is enough to raise eyebrows about the organization’s actual motives.
But I must emphasize: There is no specific evidence to date that Collective Shout (or Melinda in particular) holds any specific anti-LGBTQ views. Melinda has
previously threatened to sue bloggers
for allegedly misrepresenting her viewpoint before, so being careless with these assertions is not a good idea.
All that said, anti-abortion politics and opposition to LGBT rights often share a bed. If someone uncovers proof of their stance either way, I will update this section at a later date.
But for now, it remains to be seen. I urge people to not spread unsubstantiated claims online. Misinformation doesn’t help you.
Why Oppose Collective Shout?
If you read into the
specific
types of pornographic content that were being targeted by Collective Shout, it’s quite harrowing.
At the top of the list was an incest rape game called
No Mercy
, which has separately
sparked outrage for glorifying sexual abuse
. This is disgusting stuff, and will make many people sympathetic to its removal. I personally won’t lose any sleep over finding out that glorifying rape isn’t profitable.
The problem, however, is
how
Collective Shout achieved its goals.
They didn’t succeed through a petition to Steam, or to one of the governments that have jurisdiction over Steam and/or the developer of this game.
They pressured the payment processors into demanding Steam and itch.io comply with the activists’ demands. The term of art for this extralegal tactic is
“jawboning”
.
Neither Visa nor Mastercard are elected by the people, yet they have unchecked power to decide who can engage in commerce on the Internet.
This is a vulnerability that will be exploited by other groups unless we close it.
Even if we are ultra-charitable and assume that Collective Shout will never try to scrub LGBTQIA+ content from the Internet, what’s to stop another “Christian” anti-queer organization from learning from their victory and increasing the pressure?
What’s to stop someone from using the same exact tactic to censor my blog for *checks notes* being perceived by Hacker News users as “pornographic” just because I’m a furry?
Art:
AJ
To right-wing extremists that don the cloak of Christianity for their bigotry, such at the Heritage Foundation, any visible queerness is framed as pornographic, and therefore must be purged for the sake of “the children.”
What Can We Do?
This is a political problem, not a technical one.
Repeat after me: all technical problems of sufficient scope or impact are actually political problems first.
Eleanor Saitta

data.title: Games Look Bad: HDR and Tone Mapping
data.author: uncircle
data.article_summary: 这篇文章讨论了游戏图形技术中的高动态范围（HDR）和色调映射（tone mapping）如何在视觉上未能达到理想效果。文章指出，尽管HDR在2005年通过《半条命2：失落的海岸》首次展示，并解决了大对比度照明计算的问题，但现代游戏在应用这些技术时常常处理不当，导致图像看起来过于游戏化，缺乏电影或照片的质感。文章以《战地1》、《神秘海域：失落的遗产》、《使命召唤：无限战争》和《地平线：零之曙光》为例，指出它们的色调映射存在问题，使得图像显得对比度过高，像是在Photoshop中随意调整过。文章还对比了电影行业，提到像Arri这样的公司通过专注于色彩和视觉效果取得了成功，而游戏行业需要在这方面进行改进，以提升视觉质量。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：视频游戏中的 photorealism（照片真实感）、对比度处理、HDR（高动态范围）技术的使用及其问题

不同观点：
• dahart 认为 RE7 的图像因为对比度高而显得更真实，而其他图像（如《塞尔达》和《GTA5》）由于对比度不足和细节过多，显得不够真实。他指出，真实照片中常有高亮和阴影，而 CG 图像过度追求每个像素的曝光，导致失真。
• esafak 认为《塞尔达：荒野之息》的截图虽然被作者视为典范，但实际上过于不真实，甚至比那些被批评的截图更不现实。
• markus_zhang 质疑为何游戏需要追求照片真实感，认为这可能对游戏质量产生负面影响，且主要受益者是显卡制造商和图形程序员。
• refactor_master 批评文章缺乏数据支持，认为 GTA 5 的截图显得死气沉沉，无法代表当前的技术水平。
• uncircle 提供了一个视频链接，解释了 tone mapping 和 photorealism 的技术难点，并指出人眼具有比 CCD 传感器更大的动态范围。
• the__alchemist 认为作者忽略了 HDR 显示器的影响以及 Unreal5 游戏的新发展，并建议增加更多正面例子进行对比。
• os2warpman 对游戏中普遍存在的“闪亮和湿润”效果提出质疑，认为这既不现实也不美观。
• paulluuk 认为对 photorealism 的评价是个人偏好问题，并指出他与作者在《地平线：零之曙光》和《塞尔达》的评价上存在分歧。
• PaulHoulie 对 HDR 的实现表示失望，认为其常导致 SDR 和 HDR 都表现不佳。
• jillesvangurp 以 X-plane 为例，说明其在物理渲染上的努力和 HDR 实现，并指出 MS Flight Simulator 虽美但不一定真实，尤其在能见度模拟上。
• serd 引用任天堂设计师横井军平的观点，认为过度追求图形真实性可能适得其反。
• can16358p 认为 HDR 本身很好，但过度使用和夸张表现（如某些三星手机屏幕）并不可取。
• perching_aix 对文章中关于动态范围的数据提出质疑，指出实际显示器的动态范围远高于文章所述。
• fabian2k 认为《地平线：零之曙光》的颜色是艺术选择，而非追求真实，并指出 HDR 在某些游戏中确实存在问题。
• craxmerax 认为当 HDR 实现得当时，能带来极大的体验提升，但大多数游戏的 HDR 实现不佳，尤其在 Windows 平台上。

补充讨论：
• 讨论中涉及的技术问题包括 tone mapping、对比度处理、HDR 实现及其在不同游戏和显示器上的表现。
• 部分评论者质疑 photorealism 是否应成为游戏开发的目标，以及其对游戏体验的影响。
• 对具体游戏截图的评价存在明显分歧，显示出个人审美和偏好在其中的作用。

Promit
Graphics
October 20, 2017
October 23, 2017
9 Minutes
This is Part 1 of a series examining techniques used in game graphics and how those techniques fail to deliver a visually appealing end result. See
Part 0
for a more thorough explanation of the idea behind it.
High dynamic range. First experienced by most consumers in late 2005, with Valve’s
Half Life 2: Lost Coast
demo. Largely faked at the time due to technical limitations, but it laid the groundwork for something we take for granted in nearly every blockbuster title. The contemporaneous reviews were nothing short of gushing. We’ve been busy making a complete god awful mess of it ever since.
Let’s review, very quickly. In the real world, the total contrast ratio between the brightest highlights and darkest shadows during a sunny day is on the order of 1,000,000:1. We would need 20 bits of
just
luminance to represent those illumination ranges, before even including color in the mix. A typical DSLR can record 12-14 bits (16,000:1 in ideal conditions). A typical screen can show 8 (curved to 600:1 or so). Your eyes… well, it’s complicated. Wikipedia claims 6.5 (100:1) static. Others disagree.
Graphics programmers came up with HDR and tone mapping to solve the problem. Both film and digital cameras have this same issue, after all. They have to take enormous contrast ratios at the input, and generate sensible images at the output. So we use HDR to store the giant range for lighting computations, and tone maps to collapse the range to screen. The tone map acts as our virtual “film”, and our virtual camera is loaded with virtual film to make our virtual image. Oh, and we also throw in some eye-related effects that make no sense in cameras and don’t appear in film for good measure. Of course we do.
And now, let’s marvel in the ways it goes spectacularly wrong.
In order:
Battlefield 1
,
Uncharted: Lost Legacy
,
Call of Duty: Infinite Warfare
, and
Horizon Zero Dawn
. HZD is a particular offender in the “terrible tone map” category and it’s one I could point to all day long. And so we run head first into the problem that plagues games today and will drive this series throughout: at first glance, these are all very pretty 2017 games and there is nothing obviously wrong with the screenshots. But all of them
feel
videogamey and none of them would pass for a film or a photograph. Or even a reasonably good offline render. Or a painting. They are instantly recognizable as video games, because only video games try to pass off these trashy contrast curves as aesthetically pleasing. These images look like a kid was playing around in Photoshop and maxed the Contrast slider. Or maybe that kid was just dragging the Curves control around at random.
The funny thing is, this actually
has
happened to movies before.
Hahaha. Look at that Smaug. He looks
terrible
. Not terrifying. This could be an in-game screenshot any day. Is it easy to pick on Peter Jackson’s
The Hobbit
? Yes, it absolutely is. But I think it serves to highlight that while technical limitations are something we absolutely struggle with in games, there is a fundamental artistic component here that is actually not that easy to get right even for film industry professionals with nearly unlimited budgets.
Allow me an aside here into the world of film production. In 2006, the founder of Oakley sunglasses decided the movie world was disingenuous in their claims of what digital cameras could and could not do, and set out to produce a new class of cinema camera with higher resolution, higher dynamic range, higher
everything
than the industry had and would exceed the technical capabilities of film in every regard. The RED One 4K was born, largely accomplishing its stated goals and being adopted almost immediately by one
Peter Jackson
. Meanwhile, a cine supply company founded in 1917 called Arri decided they don’t give a damn about resolution, and shipped the 2K Arri Alexa camera in 2010. How did it go?
2015 Oscars: Four of the five nominees in the cinematography category were photographed using the ARRI Alexa.
Happy belated 100th birthday, Arri.
So what gives? Well, in the days of film there was a lot of energy expended on developing the look of a particular film stock. It’s not just chemistry; color science and artistic qualities played heavily into designing film stocks, and good directors/cinematographers would (and still do) choose particular films to get the right feel for their productions. RED focused on exceeding the technical capabilities of film, leaving the actual color rendering largely in the hands of the studio. But Arri? Arri focused on achieving the distinctive
feel
and
visual appeal
of high quality films. They better understood that even in the big budget world of motion pictures, color rendering and luminance curves are extraordinarily difficult to nail. They perfected that piece of the puzzle and it paid off for them.

• uncircle 提供了一个视频链接，解释了 tone mapping 和 photorealism 的技术难点，并指出人眼具有比 CCD 传感器更大的动态范围。
• the__alchemist 认为作者忽略了 HDR 显示器的影响以及 Unreal5 游戏的新发展，并建议增加更多正面例子进行对比。
• os2warpman 对游戏中普遍存在的“闪亮和湿润”效果提出质疑，认为这既不现实也不美观。
• paulluuk 认为对 photorealism 的评价是个人偏好问题，并指出他与作者在《地平线：零之曙光》和《塞尔达》的评价上存在分歧。
• PaulHoulie 对 HDR 的实现表示失望，认为其常导致 SDR 和 HDR 都表现不佳。
• jillesvangurp 以 X-plane 为例，说明其在物理渲染上的努力和 HDR 实现，并指出 MS Flight Simulator 虽美但不一定真实，尤其在能见度模拟上。
• serd 引用任天堂设计师横井军平的观点，认为过度追求图形真实性可能适得其反。
• can16358p 认为 HDR 本身很好，但过度使用和夸张表现（如某些三星手机屏幕）并不可取。
• perching_aix 对文章中关于动态范围的数据提出质疑，指出实际显示器的动态范围远高于文章所述。
• fabian2k 认为《地平线：零之曙光》的颜色是艺术选择，而非追求真实，并指出 HDR 在某些游戏中确实存在问题。
• craxmerax 认为当 HDR 实现得当时，能带来极大的体验提升，但大多数游戏的 HDR 实现不佳，尤其在 Windows 平台上。

补充讨论：
• 讨论中涉及的技术问题包括 tone mapping、对比度处理、HDR 实现及其在不同游戏和显示器上的表现。
• 部分评论者质疑 photorealism 是否应成为游戏开发的目标，以及其对游戏体验的影响。
• 对具体游戏截图的评价存在明显分歧，显示出个人审美和偏好在其中的作用。

data.title: Finding Robert Bogucki, the man who disappeared on purpose
data.author: NaOH
data.article_summary: 1999年，美国人罗伯特·博古斯基（Robert Bogucki）独自进入澳大利亚大沙沙漠，引发了一场大规模国际救援行动。他在荒野中独自生存了六周，最终奇迹生还，被称为“沙漠中的奇迹”。这场事件成为国际头条，但罗伯特当时为何冒险进入沙漠及其心路历程一直成谜。二十六年后，罗伯特重返澳大利亚，与当年搜救他的原住民长老Merridoo Walbidi重逢。Merridoo曾参与搜救，他指出罗伯特当时并不了解沙漠的危险。罗伯特的冒险故事不仅是个人的生存传奇，也反映了人与自然、文化之间的交集。如今，罗伯特重回故地，试图解开当年未解的谜团，并面对那段濒临死亡的经历。

44635783.article_content:
In 1999, an American trekked into the Australian desert alone, sparking an international rescue mission. Decades later, he returns to meet the people who tried to save him from himself.
More than 26 years ago, Robert Bogucki set foot in the Great Sandy Desert.
(
ABC News: Andrew Seabourne
)
Two men are walking down a desert track.
They are from different worlds, but they have one thing in common.
They know what it's like to be alone in the vast outback wilderness of central Australia.
They know how the heat sears your skin, the way thirst chokes your throat, and the sound dingoes make when they howl in the night.
The lives of these men — an Aboriginal elder and a well-to-do American — intersected in bizarre circumstances a quarter of a century ago.
In 1999, Robert Bogucki deliberately walked into the Great Sandy Desert, triggering one of the biggest land searches Australia had ever seen, and a fierce public backlash.
Robert Bogucki was found after six weeks alone in the desert.
(
AAP: Robert Duncan
)
He was found after six weeks alone in the wilderness, in what became known as the "Miracle in the Desert".
It's an incredible story, but the questions of why Robert did what he did, and what he learnt when he skirted so close to death, remained unresolved. Until now.
Robert is back where it all began, in remote northern Western Australia, for the first time in 26 years.
"I never thought I'd come back," he says.
"It's hard to say how it feels — but there's anticipation."
For Yulparija elder Merridoo Walbidi, who was part of the Australian team that searched for Robert, it's a chance to resolve unfinished business.
Yulparija elder Merridoo Walbidi was among the Aboriginal trackers called upon to join the search team looking for Robert Bogucki.
(
ABC News: Andrew Seabourne
)
"This American bloke, he had no idea what he was getting himself into," Merridoo says.
"This is dangerous country. He shouldn't have gone into the desert. He had no idea how quick he could've been dead."
The Robert Bogucki saga made international headlines and became one of the most celebrated feats of survival in the world.
But as the key characters reunite at the scene for the first time, it will become clear that this is a story that's much bigger than one man.
The circus in the desert
It all began with the discovery of a battered blue bicycle on a remote desert path.
A group of tourists found it by accident, and reported it to local police.
Senior Sergeant Geoff Fuller took the call.
"They'd found this push bike, along with some bedding, men's clothes and empty water bottles," he recalls.
"We were concerned straight away — it was a weird place to leave a bike, so we started searching straight away."
Police officers travelled 400 kilometres south from Broome to gather evidence and film the strange scene.
Loading...
The eerie footage shows the shiny metal frame of the bicycle glinting in the sunlight. A set of footprints leads east, away from the bike — straight into the Great Sandy Desert.
It's one of the most dangerous landscapes in Australia, spanning hundreds of thousands of square kilometres.
No roads, no petrol stations, no people. Just a wide expanse of sand crawling with snakes, spiders and scorpions.
And so the painstaking search begins, a convoy of cars snaking slowly through the desert, following faint footprints in the soft sand.
Police recruit three local Aboriginal trackers to lead the way, including a young Merridoo.
Merridoo (left) joined Peter Nyaparu Bumba (centre) and Mervyn Numbargardie (right) to follow Bogucki's footprints through the desert.
(
West Australian Newspapers Limited: Robert Duncan
)
"I was thinking, 'Who's this crazy man gone into the desert?'" he recalls.
"We didn't know if we were looking for someone who was going to be dead or alive."
Also along for the ride is rookie news reporter Ben Martin, filing updates down a satellite phone.
"We inched along in this vast landscape, with no idea who this mystery man was," he says.
"Each night we'd roll out a swag under the stars, and every morning we'd start again at 4am."
Loading...
He remembers the nagging feeling that stayed with him during the search, "that over the next sand dune, we might find a dead body".
(
ABC News: Kenith Png
)
On day three of the search, police make a breakthrough.
They find a hotel receipt buried in the clothing that was left with the bike.
The ghost they are stalking has a name: Robert Bogucki.
"It was a game changer," recalls Senior Sergeant Fuller, now retired.
Listen to the podcast
Season five of Expanse tells the extraordinary story of Robert Bogucki's survival in the Great Sandy Desert, and his return to Australia decades later.
Read more
Immigration authorities confirm the missing man is an Alaskan tourist who had arrived in Australia eight months earlier.
When police track down Robert's parents and girlfriend in the US, they have startling news.

data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：Kiro和其他AI编码工具（如Claude Code、Replit、Cursor）的比较与使用体验

不同观点：
• Konart认为，使用Kiro等工具迫使他重新思考开发过程，更多地关注需求分析和架构设计，而不是直接写代码。这应是资深开发者的常见经验，但Kiro强化了这种习惯。
• Agrippanux分享了他使用Claude Code的体验，通过多个代理进行计划和审查，3小时内完成了传统开发需要2天的任务。他推荐Claude Code的代理功能，认为这种工作流能提高效率。
• Hansmayer对机器生成内容的真实性表示怀疑，认为作者应更多分享使用工具的真实经验，而非依赖机器生成内容。
• Danr4表示，未提及Claude Code的文章对他没有价值，无法进行有意义的比较。
• Cu3PO42提到，Kiro生成的代码量过大，虽然功能实现但过于复杂，需要手动优化，说明Kiro可能存在过度工程化的问题。
• Sqrtc认为，Kiro帮助他更清晰地思考问题，特别是在处理复杂任务时，但希望测试反馈循环能更简洁。
• Gbrindisi调侃说，如果文章是用AI写的，就不应该再用AI来总结。
• Lvl155批评Kiro没有增加实际价值，认为其功能在其他工具中早已存在，且Amazon的推广视频浪费了时间。
• 999900000999指出，Kiro的优势在于Amazon支付LLM使用费用，而Claude Code等工具需要个人付费，降低LLM成本是未来的竞争关键。
• Glietu认为，基于规格的开发对非编码背景的人非常有帮助，可以帮助他们完成项目。
• Iamkonstantin质疑Kiro相对于Claude Code的CLI有何新增功能，认为Kiro只是强化了项目初期的规划和执行过程。
• Adamgordonbell认为，Kiro的迭代规格和任务列表方法更像项目管理（PM），可能更适合PM类型的人员而非独立开发者。
• Semaphor表示，Kiro的多步骤手动 refinement 功能使其优于其他工具，使用后其他工具感觉不足。
• Sgt101比较了Kiro、Replit和Cursor的使用体验，认为Replit更自主但有时会卡住，Cursor让他对代码库有更多控制，Kiro则像盲目的过程，结果不可控。

补充讨论：
• 争议的焦点在于Kiro是否真正带来了新的价值，还是只是现有工具和方法的重复。
• 不同用户对Kiro的体验差异较大，有人认为它提高了效率，有人则认为它生成的代码过于复杂或不可控。
• 使用AI工具进行开发的工作流和思维方式的变化是讨论的另一核心，特别是对开发经验和项目管理的影响。
• 降低LLM使用成本是用户关注的未来竞争点。

data.title: XMPP: When a 25-Year-Old Protocol Becomes Strategic Again
data.author: neustradamus
data.article_summary: 文章主要讨论了XMPP（可扩展消息与存在协议）在即时通讯领域的持续重要性及其优势。XMPP经过二十多年的发展，已成为成熟、标准化、模块化和可扩展的协议，适用于去中心化和联邦式通讯系统，支持端到端加密、多设备同步、群聊等功能，并可通过开放规范（XEPs）不断演进。文章同时对比了新推出的区块链消息协议XMTP，指出其名称易引发混淆，尽管与XMPP名字相似，但两者在架构和社区上并无联系。文章认为，在当前数字化基础设施和互操作性需求日益重要的背景下，不应忽视XMPP这样成熟且可扩展的基础，而应在其上进行扩展和创新，以满足包括Web3在内的未来通讯需求。文章最后强调，不应轻易忽视现有协议而重复建设，XMPP已经具备适应未来通讯需求的能力。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：XMPP技术的优劣以及其在即时通讯应用中的使用情况

不同观点：
• jsejcksn认为XMPP技术因Google Talk的使用而受到关注，并提到近年来自己使用的是Matrix，该技术在相关社区中被频繁讨论。
• rafaelcosta指出XMPP从广泛使用到不再流行是有原因的。除了大公司对生态系统的封锁，XMPP的"可扩展性"也导致了服务器之间的支持差异，某些服务器支持特定的XEP，而有些不支持。此外，他认为XML在当今的开发中体验不佳。
• 1970-01-01反驳XMPP成熟、开放和安全的观点，将其比喻为需要大量经验才能正确构建的DIY模型套件，不如Lego简单易用，暗示其对普通用户不够友好。

补充讨论：
• XMPP的可扩展性（XEP）导致不同服务器功能不一致，影响了其广泛应用。
• XML作为XMPP的基础技术，被认为在现代开发中体验较差。
• XMPP的开放性和社区治理模式被认为既是优势也是劣势，取决于用户的开发经验和技术背景。
• Matrix被提及作为替代方案，在相关社区中受到关注。

44680842.article_content:
Table of contents
After twenty-five years,
XMPP
(Extensible Messaging and Presence Protocol) is still here. Mature, proven, modular, and standardized, it may well be
the most solid foundation available today
to build the future of messaging.
And now, XMPP is more relevant than ever: its resurgence is driven by European digital sovereignty efforts, renewed focus on interoperability, and the growing need for long-term, vendor-independent infrastructure.
Against this backdrop, the recent funding round around
XMTP
(Extensible Message Transport Protocol)
, a newly launched blockchain-based protocol marketed as a universal messaging layer, raises questions. The name clearly evokes XMPP, yet there is no technological or community connection. And while XMPP could easily serve as a transport layer for blockchain-integrated messaging,
XMTP chooses to ignore this legacy and start anew
.
So the real question is:
Why rebuild from scratch when a solid, extensible foundation already exists?
A Protocol That Never Went Away
XMPP is an open protocol for real-time messaging, designed from the start for federation and decentralization. Standardized by the IETF (RFC 6120, 6121, 7622…), it has powered mission-critical systems for decades: enterprise communication, mobile apps at scale, online games, IoT control platforms.
What makes XMPP especially powerful is not just its architectural simplicity, but its
modular extensibility
. The protocol evolves through an ecosystem of open specifications (XEPs), covering:
End-to-end encryption (OMEMO, OTR)
Multi-device synchronization (Message Archive Management)
Group chat with subscriptions (MUC and MUCSub)
PubSub (XEP-0060) for real-time data and events
Interoperability bridges (SIP, MQTT, Matrix)
And more…
XMPP
has never stopped evolving
. Dozens of new extensions are proposed every year. It remains one of the most adaptable foundations for building secure, federated, and future-ready messaging systems.
XMTP: A New Protocol with a Familiar Name, but a Different Approach
XMTP is a blockchain-native messaging protocol developed by Ephemera. It aims to connect wallets and dApps, leveraging decentralized infrastructure (libp2p, IPFS-style storage) and cryptographic identities.
The ambition is clear: to build a censorship-resistant, peer-to-peer messaging layer for Web3, rooted in crypto-native identity and cryptography.
However, the naming is misleading. In an
older interview
, XMTP co-founder Matt Galligan said the name is a blend of SMTP and XMPP. It was chosen to evoke familiarity, perhaps even as a tribute. But
the result is confusing
: XMTP is not an extension, evolution, or even distant cousin of XMPP. There is no shared architecture, no interoperability, no community overlap.
Why This Matters Right Now
This naming issue would be minor if it weren’t happening at a
critical time for protocol design
. Governments, especially in Europe, are actively exploring how to regain control over digital infrastructure. Messaging is central to this effort, especially with upcoming interoperability mandates, data sovereignty requirements, and the need for long-term maintainability.
XMPP is uniquely well-positioned
to meet these needs. It is mature, open, extensible, and governed through transparent standards. It has a community of engineers, operators, and developers actively maintaining and evolving it.
Instead of inventing closed messaging stacks around new ecosystems, the more pragmatic move would be to
build on robust, extensible layers like XMPP
:
Need to integrate blockchain identities? XMPP can map public keys or wallet identifiers through custom namespaces or JIDs.
Need cryptographic message-level guarantees? XMPP already supports message metadata, signatures, and encryption.
Need better privacy ? XMPP can be run over privacy-preserving transports like Tor.
In short:
XMPP can serve as a transport layer for Web3 communication
without discarding two decades of protocol maturity.
I understand that the main focus of XMTP is to prevent censorship, but this really a situation that can be mitigated efficiently with XMPP. You can for example run your own server or develop a fully decentralized approach that you can leverage as needed (e.g.
xmpp-overlay
).
Yes, there is still work to be done. For example, integrating
MLS (Messaging Layer Security)
into XMPP would provide a strong foundation for interoperable, end-to-end encrypted group messaging. But that only reinforces the point:
Why ignore what’s already working and extensible?
Use What Works
New ideas are always welcome. Innovation matters. But messaging protocols are infrastructure. Reinventing them lightly, is not harmless, especially when it is done without acknowledging existing efforts.
Instead of multiplying disconnected stacks, we should
double down on what works
.
XMPP is here. It works. It evolves.
It can be extended, adapted, and integrated, even into blockchain-native systems, without sacrificing openness or interoperability.

44680842.article_summary: 文章主要讨论了XMPP（可扩展消息与存在协议）在即时通讯领域的持续重要性及其优势。XMPP经过二十多年的发展，已成为成熟、标准化、模块化和可扩展的协议，适用于去中心化和联邦式通讯系统，支持端到端加密、多设备同步、群聊等功能，并可通过开放规范（XEPs）不断演进。文章同时对比了新推出的区块链消息协议XMTP，指出其名称易引发混淆，尽管与XMPP名字相似，但两者在架构和社区上并无联系。文章认为，在当前数字化基础设施和互操作性需求日益重要的背景下，不应忽视XMPP这样成熟且可扩展的基础，而应在其上进行扩展和创新，以满足包括Web3在内的未来通讯需求。文章最后强调，不应轻易忽视现有协议而重复建设，XMPP已经具备适应未来通讯需求的能力。

data.title: 3-JSON
data.author: RGBCube
data.article_summary: 文章主要描述了`tree`命令行工具在2.0.0版本中引入的一个新功能，即如果文件描述符3（"stddata"）存在，它会自动输出未缩进的JSON格式数据。然而，这个功能在2.0.2版本中引发了问题，因为许多脚本会随意传递文件描述符，导致意外行为。为解决此问题，开发者在后续版本中修改了该功能，只有当环境变量`STDDATA_FD`存在或被设置为特定描述符时，才会输出JSON数据。文章还展示了使用该功能生成的一个目录结构的JSON示例，以及在`nushell`中如何处理这些JSON数据。最终强调了在用户环境中假设任何设置都可能引发问题。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：对在命令行和脚本环境中添加stddata FD（文件描述符）或类似机制的可行性、设计及潜在问题的讨论。

不同观点：
• cryptonector认为，在现有的代码中添加stddata FD约定是危险的，因为大量代码会关闭不想要的FD并打开其他FD。他建议引入新的系统调用，返回隐藏stddata FD的副本或创建/替换它，而不是直接使用文件描述符3。
• veltas指出，环境变量和全局变量类似，都不是理想的解决方案，但STDDATA_FD比直接使用文件描述符3更不容易冲突。他还担心脚本在不相关的场景中使用这个变量会导致问题，并建议使用参数或argv[0]代替。
• smarx007支持stddata的引入，认为这是早就应该实现的功能，类似于PowerShell中的结构化输出，可以在不破坏现有系统的情况下接近实现这一目标。
• mmastrac批评stdX流的默认处理方式，认为文件句柄的默认继承是一个重大错误，并建议如果stdX流被定义为套接字可能会更好。
• gerikson引用"C shell considered harmful"文章，指出shell脚本中随意使用文件描述符的问题早已有文献记载，stddata的引入确实会引发一些混乱。
• superdisk的发言较为离题，提到tree命令的实现地点，并表示想与作者见面，与核心讨论关系不大。
• krick对讨论背景感到困惑，不明白为什么不直接使用-J标志输出JSON，并对tree作者硬编码特定文件描述符的行为表示不满。
• NoboruWataya同样对stddata不熟悉，询问哪个环境提供这个功能。
• zbendefy的发言基本离题，提到网页设计效果，与技术讨论无关。
• EdSchouten建议引入一种新的系统调用或posix_spawn变种，可以直接指定子进程中的文件描述符，简化管理FD的过程。
• Joker_vD强烈反对随意使用未指定的文件描述符，认为这是用户环境的特定设置，应用程序应尊重用户的设置和目标，而不是破坏这种可组合性。
• fvwmuser提到FreeBSD的libxo库已经实现了类似功能，认为这不是新概念。
• williamcotton关注消除管道步骤之间的序列化和反序列化，以提高效率。
• dodomodo对nushell的输出格式不满，认为PowerShell的输出对齐更好，批评最近因ligature滥用导致的难以阅读的文本输出。
• js8建议使用比JSON更合理的协议，如CBOR，以提高数据传输效率。

补充讨论：
• 争议焦点在于stddata FD的引入是否会导致现有脚本和程序出现不可预见的问题，以及是否有更好的替代方案（如新的系统调用或参数化方法）。
• 部分参与者对文件描述符的默认继承和处理方式提出批评，认为当前设计存在根本性缺陷。
• 讨论还涉及输出格式（JSON vs CBOR）和文本对齐问题，反映了对数据表示方式的不同偏好。

data.title: Show HN: Apple Health MCP Server
data.author: _neil
data.article_summary: 这篇文章介绍了一个名为 **Apple Health MCP Server** 的项目，它允许用户通过自然语言和SQL查询Apple Health数据。该项目使用DuckDB进行高效的数据分析，目前依赖于Eric Wolter的**Simple Health Export CSV**应用来导出Apple Health数据为CSV格式。主要功能包括自然语言查询、SQL查询执行、自动生成健康报告、高效数据加载和智能缓存。用户可以通过npx直接使用该项目，并需要设置环境变量如`HEALTH_DATA_DIR`来指定CSV文件目录。项目提供了多种工具如`health_schema`、`health_query`和`health_report`来帮助分析和查询健康数据。开发者可以克隆项目并按照说明进行本地开发，同时也欢迎贡献代码，但需遵循项目规范。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：从Apple Health导出和分析健康数据的工具和方法

不同观点：
• **数据导出与安全**：[woodylondon]和[formerly_proven]讨论了从Apple Health导出数据的不同方法。[woodylondon]提到手动导出CSV的局限性，并创建了一个自动化工具将健康数据导出到云数据库，但关注数据安全问题。而[formerly_proven]则指出Apple Health原生导出功能会生成大量XML数据，但这些数据描述性强，且无需借助第三方应用。

• **工具和实现方法**：[hcm]和[monatron]分享了具体的工具和方法，如使用`healthkit-to-sqlite`将Apple Health数据导入duckdb，或通过Auto Export将数据导出到SQLite数据库。[monatron]还提到计划构建一个基于健康数据的健身代理应用。[hcm]则对现有的工具表示赞赏。

• **AI与数据分析**：[friggeri]和[brandonb]关注AI在分析健康数据和制定健身计划中的应用。他们讨论了AI在分析和制定计划中的一些挑战，如需要人工干预和数据整合。[brandonb]特别提到iPhone和Apple Watch生成的生物标志物数据丰富，但分析能力有限，表达了合作兴趣。

• **数据集成与扩展**：[voska]提到其团队开发的Sensai.fit平台，旨在解决健康数据分析问题。[vincvinc]则关心健康数据与其他平台的互兼容性，并询问是否有相关法律或倡导。

• **其他功能需求**：[beaker52]希望代理应用能够更新如血压和体重等数据。[solarkraft]则表达了对屏幕时间数据未包含在Apple Health中的失望。[ellisv]询问导出的数据是否包含健康记录（如来自Epic的数据）。

补充讨论：
• 讨论中多次提到数据安全和隐私问题，反映了用户对第三方应用访问健康数据的担忧。
• 多个评论提到使用AI和自动化工具来分析和利用健康数据，显示了对智能健康管理的需求和兴趣。
• 数据互兼容性和法律/倡导问题也被提及，表明用户对健康数据跨平台集成的需求。
